title: 가수처럼 노래해요: 누구처럼, 무엇처럼?
objective: By the end, you can attach 처럼 to a noun to compare or describe ("like a singer," "as cold as ice"), write it without a space, and tell it apart from 보다 ("than").
summary: Learn the particle 처럼 to say that someone or something does or is something "like" another person or thing.

task.title: Use 처럼 correctly
task.line: Fill in, choose, fix, order, or write each sentence, using what you learned about 처럼 on page 1.

forms.when: After any noun, whether it ends in a vowel or a consonant. The form is the same: 처럼 never changes. Put the verb after it.
forms.means: does something like N / the way N does
forms.exampleMeaning: My younger sibling sings like a singer.

forms.when: After any noun, whether it ends in a vowel or a consonant. Put an adjective after it to say what something is like.
forms.means: is like N / as ... as N
forms.exampleMeaning: The child's hands are as cold as ice.

forms.when: To say 'like me', 'like my mom', and so on. Use 저처럼 or 나처럼, never 제가처럼.
forms.exampleMeaning: Try exercising in the morning, like I do.

forms.when: Put N처럼 before a describing word (adjective or verb) that comes in front of a noun.
forms.exampleMeaning: I want to become a cool person like my dad.

watchOut: 가수 처럼 (X) → 가수처럼 (O): 처럼 is a particle, so write it attached to the noun with no space.
친구가처럼 (X) → 친구처럼 (O): Do not put 이/가 or 을/를 before 처럼. Attach 처럼 straight to the noun.
형은 저처럼 키가 더 커요 (X) → 형은 저보다 키가 더 커요 (O): 처럼 means 'like' (the same). For 'more than', use 보다.
exercises: Fill in the blank with the word in brackets + 처럼: 우리 할머니는 ____ 요리를 잘하세요. (요리사)
Choose the correct word: ① 동생이 (곰처럼 / 곰이처럼) 많이 자요. ② 우리 집 강아지는 (사람처럼 / 사람 처럼) 텔레비전을 봐요. ③ 이 가방이 그 가방(처럼 / 보다) 더 비싸요.
Find and fix the mistake: 제 친구는 한국 사람이처럼 한국어를 잘해요.
Put the words in order to make a sentence. Start with 오늘 하늘이: 파래요 / 바다처럼
Read and answer in English: 민수는 아버지처럼 키가 커요. Is Minsu's father tall?
Write the sentence in Korean using 처럼: My child is kind, like an angel. (우리 아이, 천사, 착하다)
answers: ① 곰처럼 ② 사람처럼 ③ 보다
한국 사람이처럼 → 한국 사람처럼 (제 친구는 한국 사람처럼 한국어를 잘해요.)
Yes. Minsu is tall, and his father is tall too.
우리 아이는 천사처럼 착해요. (우리 아이가 천사처럼 착해요.)
